name: xtty
description: The visual language of xtty, a native macOS terminal emulator. Stock-native chrome with almost no custom identity outside the terminal grid itself — restraint by inheriting AppKit and SwiftUI defaults.

source.origin: Hand-authored by reading xtty's own shipped Swift source (App/*.swift, XttyCore/Sources/XttyCore/). Not a brand extraction: xtty has no website, and Open Design's importers scan CSS/Tailwind/React-family files only, so no tool can derive this package. See research/03-analysis/open-design-integration-forensics.md.
source.doNotRegenerate: NEVER run 'Import from folder' (import-local) against this directory: it regenerates DESIGN.md from a CSS/JS scan and destroys the authored prose. Register by symlink via `make design-link`. The separate project-folder import used for design/mockups/ is safe and unrelated.
